ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: An experiment is conducted to evaluate the amount of DNA present during a complete cell cycle. At the start of the experiment, all cells are in a synchronized state. During the experiment, a fluorescent chemical is applied to the cells, and it fluoresces only when bound to DNA. The experimental results are shown in the figure. By observing differences in cell appearance under a microscope or changes in the detected amount of DNA, determine the different stages of the cell cycle and label them with the letters A-D. In these cells, how long does S phase take? A. 15min B. 20min C. 30min D. 40min

The curve remains on a low plateau in segment A, with the DNA fluorescence amount about 1; after entering segment B, the curve begins to rise diagonally from about 50 min, reaching 2 at about 80 min; afterward, segment C remains on a plateau near 2, and after segment D the curve drops back to 1, then later enters segment A again. In the cell cycle, S phase is the DNA replication phase, characterized by the gradual increase of DNA content, so it corresponds to segment B in the figure. Segment B lasts from about 50 min to 80 min, and the time is 80 - 50 = 30 min. Therefore S phase takes 30 min, corresponding to option C.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：曲线在 A 段为低平台，进入 B 段后斜线上升，到 80 min 达到 2 单位。根据题干说明荧光量反映 DNA 量，S 期应对应 DNA 含量增加的区间，即图中的 B 段。读出 B 段约从 50 min 到 80 min，计算持续时间 80-50=30 min，对应选项 C。
